{{author}} welcome, and thanks for the first contribution!

One thing that surprises people: if this is the first pull request from your fork, its CI run waits for a maintainer to approve it before it starts. That is normal, and usually quick. You do not have to push an empty commit or re-open anything; if it is still waiting after a few hours, say so here.

If you get stuck, or want to ask something before you write the code: the people building OBS Rust are on [Discord](https://discord.gg/6MWWX4x9pf). Ask a question, tell us what works or breaks on your setup, or follow the port as it lands. No question is too small.

For longer ideas and suggestions, [start a discussion](https://github.com/obs-rust/obs-studio/discussions).
